# BroxStudies

BroxStudies is an AI-powered learning platform for Ghanaian SHS, STEM, and TVET students.

## Main pages

- [BroxStudies home](https://broxstudies.com/)
- [Product overview](https://broxstudies.com/welcome)
- [Documentation](https://broxstudies.com/docs)
- [Student signup](https://broxstudies.com/signup)

## Guidance

Public product and documentation pages may be indexed. Account, administration, and API routes are not public content.
